scope: 103 PDF positions, manually reviewed semantic Word/form matches against actual loadCourse overlays; no product changes

definitions.lesson_core: The matched Word ID occurs in this lesson route part.words.
definitions.lesson_supplementary: Matched Word ID is linked to this lesson through lessonIds but not in its core part.words. This does not imply readiness or a complete lesson route.
definitions.corpus_other_lesson: An equivalent standalone Word/form exists but is not linked to the PDF lesson.
definitions.no_standalone_record: No equivalent whole standalone Word/form; examples, counter-generated forms, and partial base-word coverage are recorded separately. This is NOT necessarily complete absence of the concept.
definitions.variant_or_form: Orthogonal match qualifier; included in its actual lesson availability count. Parenthetical NA, optional phrase/verb, explicit reading/spelling forms are five annotated positions. Template tildes/spacing are reported separately.

Нет самостоятельной Word/form записи вопроса. В core l03-business-card-01 есть おなまえはなんですか。 («Как вас зовут?»), пример у word.c4ae772a6dc8e374. Существительное おなまえ не приравнено к целому вопросу.
